english: times change, and we change with them

terms.latin: Tempora mūtantur, nōs et mūtāmur in illīs.
terms.comment: A modern hexameter, not an ancient line: the Cambridge comedy Pedantius has Sīc tempora mūtantur, et nōs mūtāmur in illīs (1.3). The Gesta Rōmānōrum has a medieval forerunner, tempora mūtantur, hominēs dēteriōrantur.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
